sources.title: Computing the Hit Rate of Similarity Caching
sources.snippet: Similarity caching allows requests for an item \(i\) to be served by a similar item \(i'\). Applications include recommendation systems, multimedia retrieval, and machine learning. Recently, many similarity caching policies have been proposed, but still we do not know how to compute the hit rate even for the simplest policies, like SIM-LRU and RND-LRU that are straightforward modifications of classical caching algorithms.
